cromia-channels.sitebrew:
Create a responsive Cromia Channels component for Sitebrew in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Individual editable hue, saturation, brightness, and alpha sliders built with Cromia headless color picker primitives. Layout features numeric degrees/percentages for each channel, gradient-filled slider tracks, and a live synchronized color swatch. Accept editable props with realistic defaults, and display a working preview.
